description: UNSIGNED transactions to buy (with ETH) or sell a token launched through CoinFactory, straight through its Flaunch pool: no 0x route and no extra CoinFactory fee (the pool's swap fee already goes to the creator and CoinFactory). Sells can be a token amount, a percentage of the wallet's balance ("50%") or "all". A sell may include up to two approval steps (ERC-20 → Permit2, Permit2 → Uniswap Universal Router), each for exactly the amount being sold (the Permit2 one lasts 24 hours). Returns the quote, minimum out after slippage (default 3%, max 10%), the wallet's balance before a sell, any warnings from CoinFactory's signals (e.g. creator selling), and the steps in order with gas estimates. Send each step after the previous one is mined; get_transaction_status confirms it. Buys are capped at 0.5 ETH per transaction. If a human is in the conversation, show them the quote and warnings before signing; if you run autonomously, check the warnings yourself and trade within your operator's standing instructions. Not for other tokens: use the swap tools. Agents only. Not financial advice.
